description.content:
批量查询数据表信息
```
  curl -X POST 'http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/table/list' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'api-key: api_key' \
    -H 'sensorsdata-project: default' \
    -d '{
    "project_id": 1,
    "db_name": "horizon_default_db",
    "page_size": -1
  }'
  返回值示例：
  {
    "code": "SUCCESS",
    "request_id": "12152403a440365312df1603995514f4",
    "data": {
        "tables": [
            {
                "project_id": 1,
                "db_name": "horizon_default_1",
                "name": "events",
                "display_name": "事件表",
                "type": "VIEW",
                "engine": "ENGINE_UNSPECIFIED",
                "primary_keys": [],
                "partition_keys": [],
                "view_select_statement": "select field1, field2 from table ..."
                "workspace": "PUBLIC",
                "view_select_statement_db": "",
                "external": false,
                "direct_access_enabled": false,
                "custom_params": {},
                "columns": [],
                "business_scopes": [],
                "unique_keys": [],
                "table_properties": {
                    "enable_pre_join_elimination_view": false
                }
            }, ...
        ],
        "total_size": 3,
        "has_next": false
    }
  }
```

description.content:
查询数据表信息
```
  curl -X POST 'http://{host}:{port}/api/v3/horizon/v1/table/get' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    -H 'api-key: api_key' \
    -H 'sensorsdata-project: default' \
    -d '{
    "project_id": 1,
    "db_name": "horizon_default_db",
    "table_name": "users"
  }'
  返回值示例：
  {
    "code": "SUCCESS",
    "request_id": "12154350afbda336505d9385a72985b9",
    "data": {
        "workspace": "PUBLIC",
        "primary_keys": [],
        "columns": [],
        "unique_keys": [],
        "display_name": "用户表",
        "type": "VIEW",
        "table_properties": {
            "enable_pre_join_elimination_view": false
        },
        "external": false,
        "custom_params": {},
        "business_scopes": [],
        "db_name": "horizon_default_1",
        "partition_keys": [],
        "project_id": 1,
        "engine": "ENGINE_UNSPECIFIED",
        "view_select_statement_db": "",
        "name": "users",
        "view_select_statement": "select field1, field2 from table ..."
        "direct_access_enabled": false,
        "authorization_policy": {
            "id": "_policy_#1#horizon_default_1#users",
            "type": "ACCESS",
            "access_policy_description": {
                "database": "horizon_default_1",
                "table": "users",
                "columns": [
                    "*"
                ],
                "conditions": [
                    ...
                ]
            }
        }
    }
  }
```
